name: Falling Tree
disable: DC 21 Nature check (trained) to predict and avoid the tree's collapse location or DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to prop it up.

items.name: Timber!
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the area of collapse

---

Effect The tree falls over, dealing 4d8+10 bludgeoning damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 basic Reflex save).

text: A partially sawn tree collapses onto the path.
